main.description: A recorded physical activity such as a bike ride.

elapsedTime.description: Total elapsed time in seconds, including stopped time.

movingTime.description: Time spent in motion in seconds.

distance.description: Total distance in meters. String-encoded decimal number, e.g. '51214.6'.

elevationGain.description: Total elevation gain in meters. String-encoded decimal number.

elevationLoss.description: Total elevation loss in meters. String-encoded decimal number.

avgSpeed.description: Average speed in meters per second. String-encoded decimal number.

maxSpeed.description: Maximum speed in meters per second. String-encoded decimal number.

avgHeartRate.description: Average heart rate in beats per minute.

maxHeartRate.description: Maximum heart rate in beats per minute.

avgCadence.description: Average cadence in revolutions per minute.

maxCadence.description: Maximum cadence in revolutions per minute.

polyline.description: Encoded polyline string representing a simplified, privacy-trimmed route for map display. Uses Google's encoded polyline algorithm format. Ingestion services should simplify polylines to fit within the 20,000 byte limit. This limit may be revisited if it proves insufficient.

device.description: Name of the device that recorded the activity.

source.description: Where the activity data was imported from.

sourceId.description: Identifier for this activity in the source system, e.g. a Strava activity ID.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when this record was created.

weather.description: Weather conditions observed during the activity.

temperature.description: Air temperature in degrees Celsius. String-encoded decimal.

apparentTemperature.description: Feels-like temperature in degrees Celsius. String-encoded decimal.

dewpoint.description: Dewpoint in degrees Celsius. String-encoded decimal.

humidity.description: Relative humidity as a percentage. String-encoded decimal.

pressure.description: Atmospheric pressure in hPa/mbar. String-encoded decimal.

windSpeed.description: Wind speed in meters per second. String-encoded decimal.

windGust.description: Wind gust speed in meters per second. String-encoded decimal.

windBearing.description: Wind direction in degrees (0-360). String-encoded decimal.

precipitationIntensity.description: Precipitation intensity in mm/hr. String-encoded decimal.

precipitationProbability.description: Precipitation probability as a percentage. String-encoded decimal.

cloudCover.description: Cloud cover as a percentage. String-encoded decimal.

visibility.description: Visibility distance in kilometers. String-encoded decimal.

avgTemperature.description: Average device-measured temperature in degrees Celsius. String-encoded decimal.

maxTemperature.description: Maximum device-measured temperature in degrees Celsius. String-encoded decimal.

aspectRatio.description: Width and height of the image, used for layout before the image loads.
